verdict.rationale: A password manager or authenticator could plausibly ship a built-in AI assistant, so this axis applies, but nothing in the evidence shows one inside 2FAS Auth, Pass or Share. The llms.txt files, .md mirrors and machine-readable pricing are documentation aimed at external AI agents, not an in-product assistant, so they earn no credit. llms.txt also states 'Public API: None'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
